speaker: NARRATOR
text: [reflective] Hans Selye's rats got sick because their lives were being turned upside down by a clumsy man with a broom. That's real. Pressure is real.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmer, inviting] But think about what your body actually does.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [slow] Your heart speeds up to send you more energy.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your breathing quickens to bring in more air.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [warmly] That's not a body breaking down.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [quiet, certain] That's a body getting ready.

speaker: YOU
text: [quiet, slower now] It's two a.m. [breath] My heart's still going fast.

speaker: YOU
text: [a small, tired smile in the voice] Okay. [beat] Okay. I'm getting ready.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: [softly] The word was invented. [pause] What you do with it is still up to you.
